parts.instructions: You are a new member of the club. Fill in the form. Write in sentences. Use 20-30 words.
parts.prompt: Talk about a time when you traveled by car?

parts.instructions: You are communicating with other members of the club in the chat room. Reply to their questions. Write in sentences. Use 30-40 words per answer.

chatMessages.messageText: Some people think that travelling by car causes traffic jams. What is your opinion?
I am going to move to the big city next month. Should I buy a new car ?
Which vehicle is more suitable for people to get to work? Car or public vehicle?

parts.instructions: You are a member of the club. Read the notice from the club president/manager and write the requested emails.
parts.managerNotice:
Dear members,
There will be a car program running across Europe. The program invites the Car Club to send 2 representatives (1 main driver and 1 passenger) and both must have good driving skills. Do you have any suggestions for the above positions?
The manager

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your friend who is also a member of Car club. Express your thoughts and feelings about the announcement and suggest what you both should do.
Write an email to the president/manager of Car club. Give your detailed feedback, propose constructive solutions for the initiative, and explain why your suggestions would benefit the club.
